llm_response.reason: The site displays multiple key scam indicators: extremely steep discounts (over 70% off), lack of any business registration info, business phone number or email, ambiguous privacy policy with no responsible company or contact, only a generic physical address (no business entity details), and SSL/security certificate issues. Payment methods are vaguely described, and there is no legal information required under Japanese law for an e-commerce site. All of these match the typical profile of a fake online shopping scam.
